# routeros_console_settings (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_console_settings" "settings" {
  log_script_errors = true
  sanitize_names    = true
  tab_width         = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `log_script_errors` (Boolean) Whether errors produced by scripts are written to the system log.
- `sanitize_names` (Boolean) Whether the console replaces characters that need quoting in names with a safe equivalent when a configuration is exported.
- `tab_width` (Number) Number of spaces a tab character expands to in the console output (1..8).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/console/settings get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_console_settings.settings "*1"
```
